3 years’ experience in an acute Professional based billing and collections department

Under the supervision of the Assistant Director, the Quality Review/EPIC Training Coordinator serves as a resource to staff in handling and troubleshooting difficult accounts, monitoring workflow, monitoring productivity and identifying underlying AR issues. Makes recommendations for resolving issues in all areas of billing/collections for Physicians Billing Financial Services and serves as a department-wide training resource. Required to have successfully completed the EPIC Certification Training program. Incumbent is responsible for ensuring that quality standards are set and maintained throughout the various units. Develops and implements training programs for all staff performing billing, follow-up and denial activities based on the department's needs and usage.
Strong leadership and interpersonal skills
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Proficient in Commercial, Medicare and Medi-Cal billing and claims processing with sound knowledge of respective rules, regulations and compliance guidelines

Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
Ability to analyze and resolve complex problems
